compiled_state.title: Update CLAUDE.md Task Completion Workflow to clarify direct vs PR mode phases
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD5: CLAUDE.md Task Completion Workflow section clarifies which phases run in direct vs PR mode

## Implementation

File: CLAUDE.md — MUST route through dso:doc-writer
doc_target: CLAUDE.md
bloat_review_required: true
max_tokens_budget: 12000

The Task Completion Workflow comment block in CLAUDE.md (section "## Task Completion Workflow") should be updated to clarify direct vs PR mode:
- In PR mode (merge.strategy=pr): step 2 becomes `gh pr create + auto-merge wait` via merge-to-main-pr.sh; validate phase may be delegated to CI when enforcement.strategy=ci; ci_trigger is implicit after PR merge
- In direct mode (merge.strategy=direct): existing 7-phase pipeline applies unchanged
- Add a one-line mode note to the existing workflow table

Non-executable instruction file — Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md applies. Test the structural boundary.

## TDD Requirement
Add test function test_task_completion_workflow_mentions_pr_mode to tests/scripts/test-claude-md-ci-review.sh (the existing test file already mapped to CLAUDE.md in .test-index):
- awk '/Task Completion Workflow/,/Session close/' CLAUDE.md | grep -qi 'merge\.strategy\|PR.*mode\|pr.*mode'
Must FAIL before CLAUDE.md is updated. Then update CLAUDE.md via doc-writer.
Also add .test-index mapping if test_task_completion_workflow_mentions_pr_mode is not already in scope via existing fuzzy match (check: basename of test file is 'test-claude-md-ci-review.sh', source is CLAUDE.md — normalized source 'claudemd', normalized test 'testclaudemdcireviewsh'; 'claudemd' IS a substring → fuzzy match covers it, no .test-index entry needed).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_task_completion_workflow_mentions_pr_mode passes
  Verify: awk '/Task Completion Workflow/,/Session close/' CLAUDE.md | grep -qi 'merge\.strategy\|PR.*mode\|pr.*mode'
- [ ] CLAUDE.md not bloated
  Verify: wc -c CLAUDE.md | awk '{exit ($1 > 50000)}'
- [ ] Doc-writer confirms zero important findings in bloat review

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
